title: Add testing knowledge: UI handlers, table relations, asserterror, fixtures (P1+P2)
summary: Adds three testing knowledge articles to BCQuality under microsoft/knowledge/testing: UI handlers in tests, pairing asserterror with expected error checks, and using library codeunits for test fixtures. Each article has a markdown page plus good and bad AL examples.
key_points: New article on UI handlers needed for UI calls in tests
New article on pairing asserterror with Assert.ExpectedError and ExpectedErrorCode
New article on using library codeunits instead of hand-rolled Init/Insert fixtures
Each article ships as a markdown file with good and bad AL samples
Content targets BC-specific test mechanics that LLMs tend to get wrong
